ModMetaData.name: Date Night
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Adds Date and Lovin slots to the Schedule tab. Dates are dinner, walks, stars, gifts — mood and opinion, no bed. Lovin uses a shared double.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: clear Date / Lovin slots back to Sleep / Anything.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/date-night Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
